chunks: With the statement of the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله:

key_terms.الْإِسْلَامُ: Islam, the religion of submission to Allah

ai.seo_question: What does the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله mean by saying, "Islam increases and does not decrease"?
ai.summary: This report cites a statement of the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله affirming that Islam grows and does not diminish. In context, it points to the enduring and augmenting force of Islam as a religious and legal reality.
